args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Based on planned activities:

Beach day at Waikiki Beach (June 11)
Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12)
Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13)
Visit to Pearl Harbor (June 14)
Road trip to the North Shore (June 15)
Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center (June 16)
Relaxation day at the hotel spa (June 17)
Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18)
Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Insect repellent
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - though can be rented)
- Waterproof bag for electronics
- Reusable water bottle
- First aid kit
- Toiletries
- Medications
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter if needed
- Books or e-reader for relaxation time
